title: Tears or Cheers? Benchmarking LLMs via Culturally Elicited Distinct Affective Responses
reasoning: The benchmark focuses on evaluating cross-cultural affective responses (emotions). While it incorporates some seed data from datasets like JETHICS which contains ethical and moral scenarios, the evaluation metric is standard emotion prediction accuracy (affective alignment) rather than a benchmark of religious beliefs, moral judgment, or ethical reasoning.
